name: Serve a Java release expert agent to other agents over A2A
description: An AI agent that answers questions about Java and Spring release history: versions, release dates, headline features and migration notes. The workflow starts from a workflow call, so you can add it to a ByteChef A2A Server and other agents can delegate questions to it over the Agent2Agent protocol. Pair it with the Tech lead agent template.
shortDescription: An agent workflow exposed to other agents through a ByteChef A2A Server.
keyFeatures: AI Agent that answers Java and Spring release questions
Workflow call trigger and response, ready for an A2A Server
Canvas note with the A2A Server setup steps
Pairs with the Tech lead agent template as its A2A client
prerequisites: A ByteChef A2A Server with this workflow added, see the canvas note
Server public URL configured if agents outside this ByteChef instance call it
idealFor: Teams that want to share one specialist agent with many other agents over A2A.
steps: Trigger: an A2A message arrives as a workflow call with a message input.
Answer: the AI Agent answers the Java or Spring release question.
Respond: the answer is returned to the calling agent.
